My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
If your tracking shows delivered but you didn’t receive the item, try these steps:
Check the delivery location – look around your door, porch, package lockers, or other common drop‑off spots. Sometimes carriers leave packages nearby.
Confirm your shipping address in your order details to make sure it was entered correctly.
Contact the shipping carrier listed on your tracking and file a missing package investigation using your tracking number.
Also keep in mind that “delivered” can sometimes mean the package was handed to a third‑party carrier or arrived at a local hub, not necessarily left at your home yet.
If you want, I can also explain what to do if the carrier says it was delivered but still can’t locate it.
